semiconductor_relevance: High — KSK Co., Ltd. is directly involved in the semiconductor assembly process through its precision machining equipment.
summary: KSK Co., Ltd. specializes in ultra-precision machining for the semiconductor industry, focusing on the production of tie bar cutting punches and dies used in trimming processes during semiconductor assembly. The company is known for its high machining accuracy and innovations in material and shape modifications to enhance component lifespan and reduce costs.
capabilities: Manufacturing of tie bar cutting punches
Manufacturing of tie bar cutting dies
Material and shape innovations for cost reduction and extended lifespan
